latest_release.name: v7.10.0
latest_release.body:
### Added

- Allow drawing Polygon and LineStrip paths by dragging, simplifying strokes into fewer vertices while preserving click-to-add input. ([#2757](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2757))
- Add 3-point circle mode (`circle_3p`) to draw circles by clicking three points on the circumference. ([#2788](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2788))
- Open JPEG 2000 Images (.jp2, .jpx, .j2k, .j2c) through Pillow with OpenJPEG support, including folder scanning and drag-and-drop, while preserving decoded pixels and transparency in memory. ([#2833](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2833))
- `labelme.log` records the platform, the installed AI runtime versions, and how long each AI model takes to load, encode an image and generate annotations, to help debug GPU problems. ([#2849](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2849))
- A Compute device Setting runs AI on the CPU, and the status bar shows while AI is running and whether it runs on the CPU. ([#2861](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2861))
- AI-Find All replaces the AI Text Prompt. It finds every object that matches a text prompt, or a box around one example that you refine with more examples and with counter-examples drawn while holding Shift, then add with Enter or discard with Esc. The whole prompt is one concept, so commas no longer split it. Each batch asks for one label, prefilled with the prompt, so "black dog" can be saved as "dog", and objects already annotated with the same Output and label are skipped. ([#2867](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2867))
- The model menu shows the download size of each model that is not downloaded yet. ([#2898](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2898))
- Resting the pointer on an AI model in the model menu shows one sentence about what it trades, such as "Most accurate, but slower than SAM 2 Base+. Best with a GPU." ([#2901](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2901))
- Hovering a row in the Shape List shows its full label in a tooltip, so labels cut off by the dock width can still be read. ([#2905](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2905))
- AI-Segment shows the progress ring at the clicked point while a slow preview runs, such as the first click on an image. ([#2936](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2936))
- AI-Segment and AI-Find All show a hint under a waiting suggestion with the keys that add or discard it and the gestures that refine it. ([#2940](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2940))
- AI-Segment and AI-Find All show how to give the first prompt when you pick the tool. ([#2942](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2942))
- Locate a moved or renamed Image from the Image Not Found dialog; choosing it updates the reference in the Annotation File. ([#2964](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/2964))
- Split the Label List into a Label set section, with an Edit… button that opens Settings at its labels, and a Found in files section for labels found in opened files. Changing the labels in Settings now updates the list right away. ([#3047](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/3047))
- Remove labels from the Label List's Found in files section and the label dialog's suggestions, one at a time or with Clear Unused. Unused labels are dimmed. Thanks to tongwentao for #2787. ([#3048](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/3048))
- Convert Shapes from the Convert To submenu in the Edit menu and the Shape context menu, keeping their Label, Group, Shape Flags, and description. The submenu lists every Shape kind; rectangle, polygon, and LineStrip convert today, and the rest are dimmed. ([#3054](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/3054))
- Convert circles, oriented rectangles, LineStrips, and masks to their bounding box, oriented rectangles to polygons, and lines and 2-point LineStrips into each other from Convert To. ([#3055](https://github.com/wkentaro/labelme/pull/3055))
- Convert circles to polygons from Convert To, choosing the Polygon Detail in a dialo
